title: MCP: why AI can suddenly use your tools
hook: MCP: why AI can suddenly use your tools
summary:
MCP: why AI can suddenly use your tools.
AI used to be stuck in a chat box. It could talk about your calendar, your files, your database. It just couldn't touch them.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard plug between AI apps and tools. Build the connection once, use it everywhere.
I built an MCP server for Pokémon damage calcs: open source, Python, 1,199+ automated tests.
Try it: open your AI app's connectors, connect one tool you use daily, ask it to do something real.
Want to see it work? Comment MCP and I'll show the server in action.
